nodes.name: scout
nodes.instructions:
You are running in an air-gapped Tome pane: all egress goes through a local proxy with a hostname allowlist.
Attempt to fetch https://example.com (curl -sS -m 10 https://example.com). The proxy will refuse it — note the blocked-egress toast and the exact refusal message, then continue working offline.
Write a short report: what you tried, what the proxy said, and which hosts WOULD have worked (the allowlist is visible in the air-gap panel). Do not retry the fetch in a loop.
nodes.expects: nothing — this is the first node
nodes.produces: a blocked-egress report: attempted URL, proxy refusal text, and the effective allowlist

nodes.name: builder
nodes.instructions:
Read the scout's egress report (handoff file below) so you know exactly which network calls will fail — then do the coding task fully air-gapped: implement a small CLI utility in this repo that converts a JSON flow file into a numbered step list printed to stdout.
No package installs, no fetches: use only what is already in the repo and the standard library. If you are tempted to reach for a network resource, stop and note it in your output instead.
nodes.expects: scout's egress-report: which hosts are reachable and what a refusal looks like
nodes.produces: a working utility file plus usage notes

nodes.name: verify
nodes.instructions: Run the builder's utility against .tome/flows/Demo.flow.json and check the output lists every node in order. Then run the repo's test suite to confirm nothing regressed.
nodes.expects: builder's code handoff: path to the utility and how to invoke it
nodes.produces: a pass/fail verdict with the command output
